methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The authors suggest a methodology to evaluate the energy performance of lighting systems. The methodology is useful in the designing time to optimize, luminaires, system and control and in management time to certificate the systems. Four energy performance indicators are suggested: EPL for the luminaires like a label, EPS for the lighting systems arrangement, EPC for the control system and EPG for the global system.

paper_type.evidence_quote: In this paper the authors suggest methods to express energy performance of interior lighting systems and to define an energy certification procedure.

evidence_quote: The theoretical electric power density is equal to: GT= Eڄ(1+pa)/ (HLڄCU) [W/m2] (2) Where: - HL [lm/W] is the lamp efficiency; - pa [p.u.] is the power needed for ballast’s operation; - CU [p.u.] is the optical type factor.

Luminaire energy performance can be evaluated by the ratio between the theoretical electric power density GT [W/m2] consumed by the whole lighting system and the selected reference illuminance value E [lux] to be maintained on the work plane [3,4]: EPL=GT/E [W/lm] (1)
